profile.headline: Tech Lead and Sr Web Developer at Alltech International, Inc.
profile.geoLocationName: Baltimore City County, Maryland, United States
profile.jobTitle: Deputy Team Lead, Tech Lead, Sr Web Developer
profile.summary:
Over twenty-five years of experience designing and developing web based, client-server and data driven software systems using a wide range of development languages, software and tools.  Performed full software development life cycle (SDLC) work in fast-paced, deadline driven environments for federal, state and commercial clients.  Highly skilled at analyzing, reverse engineering, redesigning and developing complex systems.  Able to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences effectively.

Specialties:  Full SDLC; Web and Windows Design and Development; Database Design and Development; Process Reengineering; Technical Mentoring; Technical Leadership; Project Management.

positions.title: Deputy Team Lead, Tech Lead, Sr Web Developer
positions.description:
CONTRACTED AT:  Internal Revenue Service (IRS).
CLEARANCE:   Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) - ACTIVE.

As Deputy Team Lead, I managed and assigned daily tasks for 14 senior and junior staff members who were responsible for the configuration management, software development, design and operational support on the Enterprise Telephone Data (ETD) Warehouse project.  Created and managed task project schedules.  Established operational standards for the project teams (i.e., web development, database development, operations, quality assurance (QA) testing and configuration management (CM)).  Interacted with high-level clients and effectively managed their expectations and concerns.  Conducted productive staff meetings and managed issues in a timely manner.   

As Tech Lead, I provided technical leadership for the project and its web and database development teams.  Reviewed and managed technical assignments for 11 senior and junior developers.  Planned, designed and managed development of ETD's support systems (i.e., custom data reporting system, operational data processing system, data validation and verification system).  Participated in SDLC audits for Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), Level 3.  Helped tailor the CMMI process to the project.  Reviewed and managed system problem reports and change requests.  Reviewed and verified CM documents.  

As Sr Developer, I developed and maintained ETD's support systems (i.e., custom reporting system, operational data processing system, data validation and verification system) using VB.NET, C#, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, Classic ASP, ADO, CSS, HTML, DHTML, XHTML/XSL/XML VBScript, JavaScript, T-SQL and SQL Server in a Windows network environment.  Followed and enforced guidelines to help the company achieve CMMI, Level 2 and Level 3 certification.  This certification is awarded to companies that demonstrate they consistently follow integrated practices that yield measurable, predictable success in software development.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · SQL

positions.title: Sr Web Developer
positions.description:
As Sr Developer, I performed full SDLC work on the Waste Tracking System for Waste Management, Inc., based in Houston, TX.  It used Classic ASP, ADO, CSS, HTML, DHTML, XML, VBScript, JavaScript, T-SQL and SQL Server in a Windows NT network environment.  

Interacted with mid to high level clients and effectively managed their expectations and concerns.  

Mentored junior developers on web application development approaches and techniques.  

Wrote T-SQL queries, stored procedures, indexes, jobs, views, functions and triggers that utilized best practices and techniques for optimum processing.

positions.title: Tech Lead, Sr Developer
positions.description:
As Tech Lead, I provided technical leadership on a client-server Time & Attendance System for the State of Maryland, located in Baltimore, MD.  Assigned and managed tasks for 5 senior and junior developers.  Reviewed and verified CM documents (i.e., requirements, design and test).  Interacted with mid to high level clients and effectively managed their expectations and concerns.  Mentored developers on application development approaches and techniques.  Helped establish software development, documentation, testing, installation, user support, and user training standards.

As Sr Developer, I performed full SDLC work on a client-server N-Tier Time & Attendance System.  It used Visual Basic, OOP, XML, COM, HTML, VBScript, JavaScript, CSS, ADO, T-SQL and SQL Server in a Windows NT network environment.  Wrote T-SQL queries, stored procedures, indexes, and views that utilized best practices and techniques for optimum processing.  Followed and enforced guidelines to help the company achieve CMM, Level 2 certification.  This certification is awarded to companies that demonstrate they consistently follow practices that yield measurable, predictable success in software development.

positions.title: Project Manager, Tech Lead, Sr Developer
positions.description:
CONTRACTED AT:  Andrews AFB, MD; CPOCMA, Aberdeen, MD; and CECOM, Ft. Monmouth, NJ.
CLEARANCE:  DOD Secret Clearance - Inactive.

As Project Manager, I provided managerial oversight of multiple projects, their planning, budgets, work assignments, status reports, contracts and delivery orders.  Interacted with high level clients and effectively managed their expectations and concerns.

As Tech Lead, I provided technical leadership on client-server application development projects.  Assigned and managed tasks for 5 senior and junior developers.  Reviewed and verified CM documents (i.e., requirements, design and test).  Conducted productive developer meetings and mentored staff on application development approaches and techniques.  Established software development, documentation, testing, installation, user support, and user training standards.

As Sr Developer, I performed full SDLC work on client-server database application systems using T-SQL, Erwin, Visual Basic, MS Access Basic, OOP, HTML, VBScript, JavaScript, CSS, DAO, RDO and ADO on MS Access, SQL Server and Oracle in a Windows NT network environment.  Wrote T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and triggers that utilized best practices and techniques for optimum processing.

positions.title: Systems Developer, LAN Technician
positions.description:
CONTRACTED AT:  Pentagon, US Army Information Management Support Center (IMCEN).
CLEARANCE:  DOD Secret - Inactive.

As Systems Developer, I performed full SDLC work on client-server database application systems using T-SQL, Clipper, FoxPro, Visual Basic, DAO, MS Access Basic, and MS Access in Banyan Vines and Novell network environments.  Designed application systems that were user-friendly, network compatible and utilized relational database designs.  Effectively managed multiple projects and provided helpful end user support and training.  Responded to problems promptly and resolved them in a timely manner.

As a LAN Technician, I installed and upgraded PC software and hardware (i.e., motherboards, hard drives, floppy drives, network interface cards, memory chips, etc.).

positions.title: Application Developer, LAN Administrator
positions.description:
CONTRACTED AT:  Pentagon, US Air Force of Washington (AFDW), Financial Management Information Systems (FMIS).
CLEARANCE:  DOD NAC Clearance - Inactive.

As Application Developer, I performed full SDLC work on Accounting, Payroll, and Personnel client-server database application systems using T-SQL, FoxPro, Clipper, and dBase in Harris Lanier and Banyan Vines network environments.  Designed applications that were network compatible, self-maintaining, user-friendly, utilized relational database designs, and made use of bar code processing.  Effectively managed multiple projects and provided valuable end user support and training.  Responded to software problems quickly and resolved them in a timely manner.  

As a LAN Administrator, I maintained the smooth operation of a Banyan Vines Local Area Network.  This included maintenance and routine support of file and mail servers, as well as hardware & software configuration and repair and system backups.
